submission_requirements: Public GitHub repository based on the official template
Completed metadata.json with exactly two participant prompts
Public GGUF weights excluded from Git
llama.cpp runtime with zero network access during evaluation
REPORT.md with problem, constraints, alternatives, decisions, tools, benchmarks, and visual proof
Short video no longer than 120 seconds
Plain numeric self-reported Sperf and Seff fields on Devpost

demo_video_requirements.content_notes: Explain the solution and development journey. Screenshots or short clips should also show the build in action. The rules do not publish accepted file formats or hosting requirements.

disqualifiers: Participant is not resident in an eligible African country or is below the legal age of majority
Team has more than three members
Venture or organized team is older than 12 months as of 2026-06-16
Product is fully commercialized, has active MRR, or has been a mature deployed MVP for more than six months
External dilutive capital plus non-dilutive grants exceeds USD 25,000
Submission is not original work or open-source dependencies are not cited
Repository is not public or does not use the approved template
Model is not GGUF or does not run through llama.cpp
Evaluation exceeds 8 GB RAM, OOMs, or crashes the sandbox
metadata.json contains placeholders, an invalid domain, or not exactly two participant prompts
download_model.sh requires credentials or does not place the file at _runtime.model_path

workshops.name: The Last Mile of AI: Designing for Real-World Constraints
workshops.speaker: Oji Udezue
workshops.topic: Problem selection, real-world adoption, domain opportunities, and global innovation lessons
workshops.strategy_signal: Judges want a sharply framed problem and adoption evidence, not a benchmark-only demo.

workshops.name: GPU Access for African AI Builders
workshops.speaker: Alex Tsado
workshops.topic: Expanding low-resource AI innovation using cloud GPUs
workshops.strategy_signal: Training is permitted and supported, but compute scarcity is a known constraint rather than an eligibility gate.

workshops.name: DWMCS-AI: Decentralized Wireless Mesh Connectivity Suite with Embedded AI
workshops.speaker: Dapo Sosanya
workshops.topic: Offline and resilient AI paired with mesh connectivity
workshops.strategy_signal: A load-bearing systems pairing can strengthen the integration award if the model remains evaluable in isolation.

workshops.name: Low Rank Compression of Neural Network Weights to Optimize for Local Models
workshops.speaker: Quintin Makwe
workshops.topic: Singular Value Decomposition for low-compute model compression
workshops.strategy_signal: Model compression beyond routine quantization is organizer-endorsed, but must preserve accuracy.

sidetracks.name: Best African Use Case
sidetracks.eligibility: Meaningful applicability to a real African use case

sidetracks.name: Semifinalist GPU credits
sidetracks.eligibility: Up to twenty semifinalists selected from complete Gate 2 packages

network.deploy_requirement: No blockchain or network deployment. Evaluation is CPU-only and offline.

judging_criteria.name: African Use Case Bonus
judging_criteria.notes: Devpost says up to 10 bonus points. Organizer site also publishes different bonus wording, so additive arithmetic is unresolved.

judging_criteria.name: Hardware & Thermal Penalty
judging_criteria.notes: Minus 10 points for temperature at or above 85 C or throttling. OOM or sandbox crash disqualifies.
